content: Jesus Hasakaharetyaka Tahi
Jesus kakoa Isekohaliti Waiyexe tyaonita hoka haikoaheta one Jordão xa nalita hoka hatyo Isekohalitita axanikisene maharexakiti.
Hoka nali Tihanare hasakaharetene 40-ki ferakene. Hatyokinai maisa kanakairare hekoti hoka nakehena.
Hatyaoseta Tihanare nexa ihiye: — Enore Ityaniya atyo hiso hoka exe sehalinai haikawatya nakairati hoka hikanakaira — nexa.
Nexa hoka Jesus nexa: — Exakere Iraiti Waiyexe xairatyoare tyaonita:

content.text: Haliti atyo maisa nakairati xema taita xini tyaonita —

content: nexa.
Hatyaoseta Tihanare kolatya Jesus enoakiya hoka haxerore hotikisa enomana tyotya waikohekoa tyaonitereharenai ixiyeharenae kakoita
hoka nexa: — Nisaite homana tyotya exe iyateliti, exahe exe xiyehaliti. Hiyaiya, tyotya exeharenai atyo kaxekaka nomani, hoka xala ana xamaniya atyo nisene naokowi hoka nisene.
Tyotya exeharenai atyoite homanere, hameholokoa nahalakoi hoka hawaiyetya natyo hoka — nexa.
Hoka Jesus nexa: — Exakere Iraiti Waiyexe xairatyoare tyaonita:

content.text: Hawaiyehena hiyekohase Enore, exahe ekoamaniya taita hisaohena,

content: nexa.
Hatyaoseta Tihanare kolatene Jerusalém nali hoka mokene Iraexatyakalati Hana maiyeho enoakiyere akiti hoka nexa: — Enore Ityaniya atyo hiso hoka hahalaisoahetehena exaoseta waikoa xeta.
Hiyaiya, exakere Iraiti Waiyexe xairatyoare tyaonita:

content.text: Enore ite axikatya hanjoxanai kaxaiko hiso maheta,

content: nexa.
— Exakere tehitiya xairatyoare tyaonita:

content.text: Otokaite hiso hoka maisa hikijinai hekoti kawe hamokita sehalinai hiye,

content: nexa.
Hoka Jesus nexa: — Exakere Iraiti Waiyexe xairatyoare tyaonita:
nexa.
Hatyaoseta Tihanare miyatya hahasakaharera Jesus kahare maniyata hoka xaneheta haxowaka niyahare.
Jesus Hahena Galiléia Nali Hotohare
Jesus haikoaheta Galiléia xeta hoka Isekohaliti Waiyexe niyatere tyaonita ekakoa. Etahiyakahare exaoretyoa hakákoare hatyokoa nali.
Hoka aotyakijita xahohisakoatyakalati hanakonai, exahe tyotya aexakeretyahitene.
Jesus Xane Nazaré Xeta
Jesus xane wenakalati Nazaré xeta, enaihenere nali. Hoka sábado xowaka háwenane akereta, xane xahohisakoatyakalati hanako. Nali tityoa kaexaretya maheta Iraiti Waiyexe kaxairatyakehenere,
hoka isaha enomana iraiti xakaisasehare Isaías xairala nane. Hoka omereka babera hoka kaoka exakerexe kaxairatyakehenere aose:

content.text: Xekohaseti nalitare Isekohaliti atyo tyaonita nokakoi.

Hatyo atyo aoka natyo haomana, noxakai maheta Iraiti Waiyexe maoloxaharenae ana, exahe axikatya natyo noxakai maheta mehexaikohaliti eberexotyakaharenai ana, nakaxoseheta maheta maxoseharenai, niyeheta maheta iniyalahare kaxomokakiterenai,
noxakai maheta Xekohaseti iyehetehenere haomanerenai ferakene kaotyakenehenere maheta.
Hatyaoseta Jesus ityahaheta babera hoka isehetene xahohisakoatyakalati hana kaxaikotyasehare ana hoka tyokeheta. Tyotya halitinai nali tyaoniterenai wahakotyaha Jesus ana mamahirirahareha.

content: Hatyaoseta iraehena hoka nexa: — Kalikini atyo kaotyaka Iraiti Waiyexe kaxairatyakehenere, kalikini xasemehenere tahi — nexa.
Hoka tyotyaha aexakeretyaha Jesus, hakaharetyoahitaha iraiti aihalahalinikisare iraetere kakoa hoka nexahitaha: — Xoana maisa José ityani xini? nexahitaha.

Hoka Jesus nexa: — Maisa hoka exakerexe ite xiraehitiya nomani exe iraiti: “Wairatyare, hisota hawairatyoawihena”. Exahe xexa tehitiyaite: “Hisomehena ali hawenakala kaiserehare nali, xakaitahere hománe tahi wihiye Cafarnaum naliye akereta”, xexaite — nexa ihiyeha.
Hoka nehitiya: — Aliterexe niraeta xihiye, maisa atyo hatya hekoti iraiti xakaisasehare waiye kaxomokakere ewaikoherakoa kaiserehare nali.

Xasemehena: kahare wainiyaneneronai tyaonahitaha Israel waikoherakoa nali iraiti xakaisasehare Elias xowaka, hoka maisa onehitita hanama wanone mokotexe hoka nakiti kalorexe tyaona hakákoare hatyo waikohekoa nali.

Xakore hoka Enore maisa axikaita Elias hahalonai wainiyaneneronai tyaonitolonai Israel waikohera nali ana. Hoka hahalo wainiyanenero tyaonitolo wenakalati Sarepta nali Sidom waikohekoa nali ana taita.

Nikare tehitiya kahare jijikoahiyenai tyaonita Israel waikohera nali iraiti xakaisasehare Eliseu xowaka. Xakore hoka maisa hatyanai hekoti enekonitareha kaxaiyatelikisakihitita. Naamã taita, Síria nalitare, hatyo taita atyo kaxaiyatelikisakeheta — nexa.
Hoka hatyoharenai semaha hoka tyotya xahohisakoatyakalati hanako tyaoniterenai kalore ehareha.
Hoka tityoahenahitaha, nolokasekoatyaha Jesus haware wenakalati nonitata. Xaneha ekakoa tyairi wáhaharexe nali xawatyahene maheta hatyo henota waikoa maniya. Hatyo heno atyo wenakalati kaomaka.
Xakore hoka jiyeheta halitinai konita hoka xaneheta.
Hatya Haliti Kakoa Tyaonita Isekohaliti Iniyalahare
Hatyaoseta Jesus xane Cafarnaum xeta, hatya wenakalati Galiléia koa nali. Hoka hatyo nali aotyakijita halitinai sábado xowaka.
Hoka hakaharetyoahitaha exaotyakira kakoa, iraeta atyo iyateliti kakoare hoka.
Hoka hatya haliti tyaonita xahohisakoatyakalati hanako hoka isekohaliti iniyalahare tyaonita ekakoa. Hoka kawiyatya:
— Kaxiyani! Xoare haoka wihiye, Jesus Nazaré yere? Xoana ali hisoa hamawenekoaretya maheta wiso? Waiye atyo hawaiyekehalakahareta nomani: hiso atyo Enore Xaxikalahare Waiyexe — nexa.

Hatyaoseta Jesus irae isekohaliti iniyalahare hiye: — Nikareta hirae hoka hahikoahetehena hatyo haliti nonitata! nexa. Tyotya enahalakoahitaha isekohaliti iniyalahare exoakisa haliti waikoa hoka hikoaheta enonita makawexomokalahareneta.
Hoka tyotyaha hakaharetyoaha hoka irae kakoaha hatyo tahi: — Xoarehare iraiti ala exe? Exe haliti iyateliti kakoare hoka axikaheta isekohaliti iniyalaharenai hoka xanehenahititaha! nexaha.
Hoka Jesus tahi exaoretyoa hakákoare hatyokoa nali.
Jesus Aiyatelikiheta Kahare Halitinai
Hoka Jesus hikoaheta xahohisakoatyakalati hanakota hoka xane Simão hana xeta. Hoka Simão nakero hokakita, kalore wátyahiseta, hoka xakaiha hatyoharenai Jesus hiye.
Hatyaoseta xane tityoa exehokotyoakala haliya hoka irae watere hiye. Hoka wátere tyoteheta enonitata, hoka tityoaheta rotita hoka enakairaha tyoma.
Hatyaoseta kamai isoahena hoka tyotya kahinaeharexenai hokakiterenai, kahare hawareharexe kahehaliti kakoarenai, kolatyaha Jesus ana. Hoka hakahe ekaokakisa ihiyeha hoka aiyatelikihenahitene.

Hoka tihanarenai kahare halitinai nonitata xanehenahitaha hakawiyalaha kakoa: — Hiso atyo Enore Ityani! nexahitaha. Waiyekehalakahareta atyo Jesus enomanaha. Enore Kalorexe Aohenere atyo, hoka hatyo hiyeta watyalyahitene, mairaenityahitene.
Jesus Xakaihena Iraiti Waiyexe
Hatyaoseta ferakoa hoka Jesus xaneheta wenakalatita hoka xane maharexakiti. Hoka halitinai tawehenene hoka kaokehenahitene hoka maisa xaneheta enonyahitaha aokareha.
Xakore hoka Jesus nexa: — Noxakaini tehitiya atyo haiyanaikoa wenakalati koanai Iraiti Waiyexe Enore koamaniya nawenatyaka tahi. Hiyaiya, hatyo maheta atyo Enore axikatya natyo — nexa.
Hatyo hiyeta xakaita Iraiti xahohisakoatyakalati hanakonai tyotya wenakalatikoanai.
